# Vendored from verdigris

"Vendored" means these files are copied from the suite design system into
spall's repo and committed, pinned to a verdigris release, rather than
fetched at build time. Do not edit them here: change them in verdigris,
tag a release, then re-copy ("re-vendor") from the tag.

| | |
|---|---|
| Repo | https://github.com/cschooley/verdigris |
| Tag | `v0.4.0` |
| Commit | `92d5704a1c562b6532c770a5f8638d1d6c35106e` |
| Token version | v0.4.0 (adds `--vg-boost` / `--vg-boost-glow` to all four themes) |

## Files

| File | From verdigris |
|---|---|
| `tokens.css` | `tokens/tokens.css`, generated by `build/tokens.py` (enforces WCAG AA contrast) |
| `icons/*.svg` | `icons/`: suite marks (spall, kudzu, scurf, taphttp, flux, verdigris) |
| `icons/views/*.svg` | `icons/views/`: rail view icons (engagement, traffic, surface, tasks, findings) |

Every file is pinned by sha256 in `verdigris.test.ts`, which also fails if a
file is added without being recorded. Icons are rendered through
`src/lib/svg.ts`, a strict parser (shape elements and presentation
attributes only), never as markup strings.

## Re-vendoring

1. Copy the files from the new tag (`git show <tag>:<path>`), byte for byte.
2. Update the tag, commit and notes above.
3. Update the hashes in `verdigris.test.ts` and run `npm test`.
